summary: Neo hears fast footsteps and is immediately attacked by Agent Smith, who smashes through a wall and chokes him against a pipe. Cypher identifies the attacker as an Agent. Just as Neo's [...] breaks through the same wall and tackles Agent Smith, sending both men crashing to the floor.

what_changes.after: Choked against a pipe with throat about to collapse

what_changes.before: Off-screen or outside the immediate struggle
what_changes.after: On top of Agent Smith, interrupting the choke

event_hint.one_line: Agent Smith ambushes Neo through a wall before Morpheus intervenes.
